en.title: Number of Distinct Graphs from Optional Edges
en.description:
n labeled vertices form an undirected simple graph with no self-loops and no multiple edges; the graph may be disconnected. Find the number of distinct graphs modulo 1000000007.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing n. The source gives no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤n≤10^9.
en.explanation: The examples give 64, 1 and 8 respectively; with one vertex, only the edgeless graph exists.
hints: Each pair of distinct vertices corresponds to an independent optional edge; use fast exponentiation to compute 2 to the power n(n−1)/2.
